summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and admits Tuple[ControlType, str] in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 title format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor (terminal check only, returns bool); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run, per instructions, and nothing was committed. The changes are verified by reading only.
